oracle.python:
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys
p=Path(sys.argv[1])
assert json.loads((p/"result.json").read_text()) == {'prefix': [7, 4, 4, 9, 7], 'total': 7}
assert json.loads((p/"input.json").read_text()) == [7, -3, 0, 5, -2]
